scope: Prevent nonzero TABLE group-94 border-color masks from being published as semantically complete while the selected CMC values lack a lossless typed DXF route.

authority.observation: The group-94 mask selects 18 title/header/data border CMC fields, with bits 0x01 through 0x20000. The independent DXF representability audit shows shared DXF border color groups cannot preserve arbitrary independent row values.

implementation.behavior: The parser retains m_borderColorOverrideFlags and marks the table unsupported/incomplete for any nonzero group-94 mask. Existing group-95 lineweight and group-96 visibility paths are unchanged; the DWG writer's existing color-mask refusal is unchanged.

cases: existing zero-mask border-color baseline remains complete
selected low group-94 bit is retained and marks the table incomplete
unsupported high group-94 bit is retained and marks the table incomplete

limitations: Does not decode or serialize group-94-selected border CMC values.
No producer rendering, native semantics, or wider TABLE support is qualified.
